title: 第一部分 基础训练 TEST 4

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
### Jobs at Hoburn University Sports Club

#### Football Coach Wanted
* Do you like football?
* Can you teach football?
* Can you organize(组织) a group of people?
* Can you speak English?
* Can you drive a car?

*Yes? Send us an email at jobs@uoh.edu.uk-sports.*

#### Sports Café Worker Wanted
* Do you like working with people?
* Can you cook?
* Can you speak different kinds of languages?
* Can you use a computer?

*Yes? Send us an email at jobs@uoh.edu.uk-sports.*

---

Dear Hoburn University Sports Club,

Please send me information about the job at the sports café. I am friendly and I love working with people. I can cook well, especially pasta and pizza. I can speak English, Spanish and a little German. I can use a computer very well.

Best regards,
Leo

questions.prompt: The football team at Hoburn University needs a ________.
questions.translation: 霍伯恩大学足球队需要一名 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据招聘信息标题“Football Coach Wanted”可知，足球队需要一名足球教练（coach）。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt:
If Sarah can ________, she can work for the football team.
① teach football
② speak English
③ organize a group of people
④ cook
⑤ use a computer
⑥ drive a car
questions.translation:
如果莎拉会 ________，她就可以为足球队工作。
①教足球
②讲英语
③组织群体
④烹饪
⑤使用电脑
⑥开车
questions.explanation: 根据“Football Coach Wanted”下的要求：teach football（①）、organize a group of people（③）、speak English（②）、drive a car（⑥）。因此符合条件的是①②③⑥。答案为C。

questions.prompt: If Dale wants to get a job at Hoburn University, he should ________.
options: write a letter to the sports club
send an email to the sports club
questions.translation: 如果戴尔想在霍伯恩大学获得一份工作，他应该 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据文中“Yes? Send us an email at jobs@uoh.edu.uk-sports.”可知，应给体育俱乐部发电子邮件。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: What can we know about Leo?
options: He is not good at making pizza.
questions.translation: 关于利奥我们能知道什么？
questions.explanation: 根据利奥信中的“I am friendly and I love working with people.”可知，他喜欢与人打交道/一起工作。因此答案为C。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
I visited some pandas this year during the winter holiday. It was more than just an interesting trip—it was an unforgettable experience(难忘的经历). I worked as a panda keeper. I learned how to take care of these cute animals.

At first, I was really excited. Pandas are so cute. Almost everyone likes them. But a few days later, I learned that it is hard work to be a panda keeper. I had to make food for them. I also had to clean their pen (圈) every day. Sometimes, I had to climb the mountains to make sure that they were safe. In the evening, it was cold, but I had to keep a close eye on them.

That was a great chance for me to learn more about pandas. Would you try it too?

questions.prompt: The writer likes pandas because they're ________.
questions.translation: 作者喜欢大熊猫是因为它们 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Pandas are so cute. Almost everyone likes them.”可知，大熊猫非常可爱（cute）。因此答案为A。

questions.prompt: The writer now thinks that looking after pandas is ________.
questions.translation: 作者现在认为照顾大熊猫是 ________ 的。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“...I learned that it is hard work to be a panda keeper.”可知，当熊猫饲养员是很辛苦的（hard）。因此答案为C。

questions.prompt: How often did the writer clean the pandas' pen?
questions.translation: 作者多久清理一次熊猫的圈舍？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“I also had to clean their pen every day.”可知，每天都要清理（Every day）。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: The writer climbed the mountains to ________.
questions.translation: 作者爬山是为了 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Sometimes, I had to climb the mountains to make sure that they were safe.”可知，爬山是为了确保它们的安全。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: What is the best title for the passage?
options: An experience as a panda keeper
questions.translation: 这篇文章的最佳标题是什么？
questions.explanation: 全文主要讲述作者在寒假期间担任熊猫饲养员的难忘工作经历，“An experience as a panda keeper（一段当熊猫饲养员的经历）”最契合主旨。因此答案为D。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
You like cats, but you don't have one? Then you may go to a cat café. There you can enjoy nice coffee and cakes, and of course, the company (陪伴) of lots of cats!

Cat cafés first became popular in Japan. And now you can also find them in different places across China. It is said that pets can help people feel relaxed. If you have pressure(压力) from work or study, and have no time to keep a pet, a cat café will be a good place for you. And for those cats, they have customers to play with and won't feel too lonely.

There are also dog cafés and rabbit cafés. Enjoy yourself in one of these cafés with lovely animal friends on a sunny afternoon.

questions.prompt: What can't you do in a cat café?
questions.translation: 你在猫咪咖啡馆不能做什么？
questions.explanation: 文章提到可以在猫咪咖啡馆喝咖啡、吃蛋糕、与猫咪玩耍陪伴，但没有提到可以把猫买回家。因此答案为D。

questions.prompt: Where did cat cafés first become popular?
questions.translation: 猫咪咖啡馆最早在哪里流行起来？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段第一句“Cat cafés first became popular in Japan.”可知，最早在日本流行。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: How many kinds of animals are mentioned in the passage?
questions.translation: 文章中提到了几种动物？
questions.explanation: 文中提到了 cats（猫）、dog cafés（狗）和 rabbit cafés（兔子），一共3种动物。因此答案为C。

questions.prompt: What can we know from the passage?
options: Any animal can be in a café.
Pets are helpful for people to relax.
Cats never feel lonely in cat cafés.
We have to spend a lot in a cat café.
questions.translation: 我们从文章中能了解到什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“It is said that pets can help people feel relaxed.”可知，宠物有助于人们放松身心。因此答案为B。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Ben was sad. He looked out of the car window. Mom drove past houses where people were preparing(准备) for Christmas.

Mom looked in the rearview mirror(后视镜) and asked, "What's wrong?"

"I miss my friends," said Ben.

"I know it is hard to move. You'll make some friends when school starts again."

Ben looked at Mom. "Why do we have to move at Christmas time?"

"They need your dad at his new job right away," said Mom.

Ben looked back out the window.

"I have an idea."

"What is it?" asked Ben.

"We can make cookies (曲奇饼)," said Mom.

Ben was sad. "I don't want any cookies," he said.

"They won't be for you," said Mom.

"Who will they be for?" asked Ben.

"Our neighbors," said Mom. "We can bake some cookies. Then we can take them to our neighbors. I think you'll meet some kids at your age. You can make friends with them."

questions.prompt: When did the story happen?
questions.translation: 故事发生在什么时候？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“...where people were preparing for Christmas”及后文“move at Christmas time”可知，圣诞节在12月，因此发生在12月（In December）。答案为D。

questions.prompt: Why did Ben feel sad?
options: He didn't like his new school.
questions.translation: 本为什么感到难过？
questions.explanation: 根据对话“'What's wrong?' 'I miss my friends,' said Ben.”可知，他想念他的朋友们。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: What can we know about Ben's father?
questions.translation: 关于本的父亲我们能知道什么？
questions.explanation: 根据妈妈说的“They need your dad at his new job right away”可知，本的爸爸获得了一份新工作。因此答案为B。

questions.prompt: Who will Ben's mother make cookies for?
questions.translation: 本的妈妈将为谁做曲奇饼？
questions.explanation: 根据妈妈说的“Our neighbors... Then we can take them to our neighbors.”可知，是做给新邻居们的。因此答案为D。

sections.title: 二、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
One day, my sister brought home a duck. She put him in a box with duck photos, so he wouldn't get lonely.

The duck always wanted to catch our eye. If we walked by him without taking him out of the box, he quacked(发出嘎嘎声) loudly. We put a doll nearby, and it thought of the doll as a person and quieted down.

If I came home late at night, I would try to run away from him before he saw me. Or if not, everyone would know I got home too late.

He loved TV. When he watched TV, he would keep quiet and never make a noise. He loved watching food advertisements(广告) and would peck(啄) at the vegetables on the screen.

As he grew, he didn't like to stay in his box any more. We took him to our grandparents' farm, where he could enjoy his life better.

questions.prompt: Why did the writer's sister put the duck in a box with duck photos?
options: Because the box was big and clean.
Because the duck liked taking photos.
To teach the duck how to swim.
questions.translation: 为什么作者的姐姐把鸭子放在一个贴有鸭子照片的盒子里？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“She put him in a box with duck photos, so he wouldn't get lonely.”可知，是为了不让它感到孤独。答案为B。

questions.prompt: What would happen if the writer just walked by the duck?
options: He would sleep quietly in the box.
He would jump onto the table.
questions.translation: 如果作者只是从鸭子身边走过会发生什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“If we walked by him without taking him out of the box, he quacked loudly.”可知，它会大声嘎嘎叫。答案为C。

questions.prompt: What did the duck like to watch on TV?
questions.translation: 鸭子喜欢在电视上看什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“He loved watching food advertisements and would peck at the vegetables on the screen.”可知，它喜欢看食品广告。答案为A。

questions.prompt: Where did the duck live when he grew up?
questions.translation: 鸭子长大后住在哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“We took him to our grandparents' farm, where he could enjoy his life better.”可知，送到了祖父母的农场。答案为D。

questions.prompt: What can we learn about the duck from the passage?
options: The duck hated staying with people.
The duck was cute, playful and loved attention.
The duck was very quiet all day long.
The duck could not eat vegetables.
questions.translation: 从短文中我们可以了解关于这只鸭子的什么？
questions.explanation: 通读全文可知，这只鸭子喜欢吸引人的注意、喜欢看电视、很可爱也很有趣。答案为B。
